//: The bevel gearbox: one plate for the case and forty bits of gearing inside it. Still the most expensive single block in the mod, which is right - it is the one cell where the drive turns a corner - but 4.0 ingots rather than 6.15, which puts it beside vanilla's hub-light4way at 3.
//bug: This file used to name BOTH metalplate-* and metalbit-* 'metal'. GetNameToCodeMappingForBasicWildcard ends in a plain assignment, so the last ingredient iterated wins the mapping outright - metalbit did, and it carries blistersteel, leadsolder and silversolder, which metalplate does not. Three of the generated recipes therefore asked for metalplate-blistersteel and friends, failed to resolve, and logged three errors at EVERY server start. layshaft.json and tensionhead.json had the same double-naming and were accidentally fine only because Dictionary enumeration put metalbit first. Deleting every name closes all three at once.
